meta.name: pitch-recon
meta.description: Marketing and messaging reconnaissance — read existing landing pages, copy, positioning docs, and marketing materials to understand the current messaging state. Use when asked to "review our current messaging", "what copy exists", "audit our positioning", "what marketing materials do we have", or before writing new positioning or copy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计现有营销材料和定位
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要梳理现有营销材料并找出定位问题。
copy.tagline_en: Audit existing marketing materials and positioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand your current marketing messaging state.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描你项目中的营销文案和定位文档，检查内容是否一致，然后生成一份简明的营销侦察报告，指出缺失或矛盾的地方。
howto.when: 当你要求“审查我们当前的营销文案”、“盘点现有 copy”或类似需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查项目中的营销文案和定位是否一致
say.note: Claude 会扫描文件并报告问题。

say.text: 盘点我们现有的 landing page 和标语
say.note: Claude 会列出所有营销资产并检查一致性。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scans your project for marketing copy and positioning docs, checks consistency, and produces a concise marketing reconnaissance report highlighting gaps or contradictions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "review our current messaging", "audit our positioning", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Review our marketing copy and positioning for consistency.
Take inventory of our landing pages and taglines.
say_en.note: Claude lists all marketing assets and checks alignment.
